Desativa o serviço Windows Search (WSear: Disables the Windows Search service (WSearch), which reads and indexes your files in the background.
A pesquisa do Menu Iniciar, do Explorado: Search in the Start menu, File Explorer and Outlook becomes much slower and may not find content inside files.
Sets the WSearch service to Disabled. The indexer stops running, so it causes no disk reads or CPU use in the middle of a game (it usually wakes up when the PC is idle or when many files change, such as when installing or updating games).
Menos atividade de disco e CPU em segund: Less background disk and CPU activity, especially right after installing or updating games. Bigger gain on HDDs and PCs with a weak CPU; on powerful PCs with an SSD, the FPS difference is usually small.
Alto (perda de função): a pesquisa do Wi: High (loss of function): Windows search starts scanning folders on the spot, becomes slow and does not find text inside documents and e-mails. Does not affect Windows security.
O tipo de inicialização original fica gu: The original startup type is saved; Undo returns the service to Automatic (delayed) and Windows rebuilds the index on its own.
Desativa o serviço SysMain, que pré-carr: Disables the SysMain service, which preloads the programs you use most into RAM.
Em HDD os programas e o Windows podem ab: On HDDs, programs and Windows may open more slowly.
Sets the SysMain service to Disabled. It monitors usage, preloads programs into memory and reorganizes data in the background.
Menos uso de disco e de RAM em segundo p: Less background disk and RAM use and less variation while gaming, especially on PCs with little RAM. On a fast SSD SysMain helps little, so turning it off costs almost nothing.
Alto (perda de função): programas e o pr: High (loss of function): programs and Windows itself may open more slowly, especially on HDDs. Does not affect Windows security.
Desfazer volta o serviço para Automático: Undo returns the service to Automatic.
Diretiva de Grupo que faz o Windows baix: Group Policy that makes Windows download updates only from Microsoft's servers, without sending or receiving parts from other PCs.
As atualizações continuam chegando norma: Updates keep arriving normally; they are just no longer shared between PCs.
Grava a política DODownloadMode = 0 (\"S: Writes the DODownloadMode = 0 policy ("HTTP only, no peering") in Group Policy > Windows Components > Delivery Optimization. Windows Update keeps working.
O Windows para de usar sua internet para: Windows stops using your internet connection to send parts of updates to other PCs, which avoids background uploads that raise your ping mid-match.
Alto (perda de função): em casas ou escr: High (loss of function): in homes or offices with several PCs, each one downloads everything from the internet, which uses more data. Security and updates are not affected.
Valor documentado pela Microsoft (Policy: Value documented by Microsoft (Policy CSP DeliveryOptimization/DODownloadMode). Undo removes the policy.
Diretiva de Grupo que impede o Windows d: Group Policy that stops Windows from putting background processes into power-saving mode (EcoQoS / efficiency cores).
Mais consumo de energia e calor. Em note: More power use and heat. On laptops, the battery lasts less.
Grava a política \"Desativar o Power Thr: Writes the "Turn off Power Throttling" policy (PowerThrottlingOff = 1) in Group Policy > System > Power Management > Power Throttling Settings. With it, no process is demoted to a low clock or to the efficiency cores (E-cores) just for being in the background.
Programas que o jogo usa em segundo plan: Programs the game uses in the background (Discord, recording, overlays, launchers) are not slowed down. Makes more difference on hybrid processors (Intel 12th gen or newer) and on laptops.
Alto: maior consumo, mais calor e ventoi: High: more power use, more heat and louder fans; on laptops the battery may last much less. Does not affect Windows security.
Política documentada pela Microsoft (Pow: Policy documented by Microsoft (Power Throttling). Undo removes the policy.
Extremo: agendador multimídia todo para: Extreme: multimedia scheduler all for the game
Reserva o mínimo possível de CPU para ta: Reserves as little CPU as possible for regular tasks while multimedia or a game is running and turns off the multimedia scheduler's network limit.
Downloads, chamadas e programas em segun: Downloads, calls and background programs may become slower while the game is running.
No serviço de agendamento multimídia (MM: In the Multimedia Class Scheduler Service (MMCSS): SystemResponsiveness = 10 (the default reserves 20% of the CPU for low-priority tasks; 10 is the minimum Windows accepts) and NetworkThrottlingIndex = 0xFFFFFFFF (turns off the network packet limit applied during media playback).
Mais tempo de CPU para os threads do jog: More CPU time for the game threads registered with MMCSS and no network limit coming from the multimedia scheduler. The gain is small and depends on the game; it shows more on CPUs with few cores.
Alto: programas em segundo plano (downlo: High: background programs (downloads, recording, voice calls) get less CPU and may stutter. Does not affect Windows security.
Valores documentados pela Microsoft (Mul: Values documented by Microsoft (Multimedia Class Scheduler Service). Undo restores the previous values (default: 20 and 10).
Extremo: desligar o Relatório de Erros d: Extreme: turn off Windows Error Reporting (policy)
Diretiva de Grupo que desliga o Relatóri: Group Policy that turns off Windows Error Reporting (WER) and disables its service.
Quando um jogo ou programa travar, o Win: When a game or program crashes, Windows neither creates nor sends a report; finding the cause of crashes becomes harder.
Grava a política \"Desativar o Relatório: Writes the "Disable Windows Error Reporting" policy (Disabled = 1) in Group Policy > Windows Components > Windows Error Reporting and sets the WerSvc service to Disabled.
Depois de um travamento, o Windows não f: After a crash, Windows does not keep creating dump files and sending reports in the background (this can take CPU and disk for minutes). The "looking for a solution" windows also stop appearing.
Alto (perda de função): sem relatórios d: High (loss of function): no crash reports for you, for Microsoft or for game developers; Reliability Monitor gets less information. Does not turn off any protection.
Política documentada pela Microsoft (Win: Policy documented by Microsoft (Windows Error Reporting). Undo removes the policy and returns the service to Manual.
